scoring_note: Intended for mean z-score scoring (see score_signatures.py): log2(x+1) transform, per-gene z-score across samples, signature score = mean z of member genes present in the matrix.

signatures.label: Myofibroblastic CAF
signatures.description: Contractile, ECM-depositing CAF state defined by high smooth-muscle gene expression (Acta2/Tagln) and TGFbeta-driven identity.

source.note: Markers taken from the main text (Fig. 4E-F; sub-cluster 3): "high expression of the smooth muscle genes Acta2 and Tagln, as well as Igfbp3, Thy1, Col12a1 and Thbs2".

signatures.label: Inflammatory CAF
signatures.description: Inflammatory CAF state defined by chemokine/cytokine expression (Il6, Cxcl1) and hyaluronan/ECM remodeling (Has1, Col14a1). Induced by IL-1/JAK-STAT signaling (Biffi et al., Cancer Discov 2019, PMID 30366930) and antagonized by TGFbeta.
signatures.mouse_note: Mouse lacks a functional IL-8 (Cxcl8) gene; Ly6c1 has no direct human ortholog.

source.note: Markers from main text (sub-cluster 1): Clec3b, Il6, Cxcl1, Ly6c1, plus Has1 and Col14a1 (iCAF-specific ECM deposition). Human list adds CXCL2, CCL2, CXCL12, CXCL8 per the Elyada-derived marker table in the CAF review (PMC9516766, Table 1, citing Elyada).

signatures.label: Antigen-presenting CAF
signatures.description: CAF state expressing MHC class II machinery (H2-Aa/H2-Ab1/Cd74) plus Saa3 and Slpi. Expresses pan-fibroblast markers (Col1a1, Dcn, Pdpn) at levels comparable to iCAF/myCAF, confirming fibroblast identity.
signatures.human_note: SAA3 is a pseudogene (SAA3P) in human; omitted from the human list.

source.note: Main text: "expressed genes belonging to the Major Histocompatibility Complex (MHC) class II family" plus "Serum Amyloid A3 (Saa3)" and "Secretory Leukocyte Peptidase Inhibitor (Slpi)".

signatures.label: Senescence-associated secretory phenotype
signatures.description: Core secreted factors of the senescence-associated secretory phenotype: interleukins, chemokines (GRO/MCP families), matrix metalloproteinases, IGFBPs, PAI-1, VEGF, uPA, GM-CSF, HGF. Relevant because RAS-induced senescence and therapy-induced inflammatory reprogramming converge on this program.
signatures.mouse_note: Mouse Mmp1 is annotated Mmp1a/Mmp1b; functional Cxcl8 is absent in mouse.

source.note: Core SASP factors from the oncogenic-RAS SASP proteomics in this paper: IL-6, IL-8, GRO-alpha/beta (CXCL1/2), MCP-1 (CCL2), MMP-1, MMP-3, PAI-1 (SERPINE1), VEGF, IGFBP-2/3/7, uPA (PLAU), GM-CSF, HGF.

signatures.label: Core matrisome (structural ECM)
signatures.description: Structural extracellular-matrix signature: fibrillar collagens, collagen VI, ECM glycoproteins (fibronectin, periostin, tenascin-C, SPARC, thrombospondins) and small leucine-rich proteoglycans plus versican/perlecan. Tracks fibrotic/desmoplastic stroma; expected to fall when stroma is remodeled toward a less fibrotic state.

source.note: Gene selection follows the core-matrisome definition (collagens, ECM glycoproteins, proteoglycans) from the matrisome database introduced in this paper.

signatures.label: MAPK/ERK transcriptional output
signatures.description: Canonical ERK feedback/output genes: dual-specificity phosphatases (DUSP4/6), Sprouty feedback regulators (SPRY2/4), ETS factors (ETV1/4/5), plus ERK-driven FOSL1 and CCND1. Rises with MEK-ERK activity; falls with MEK/RAS inhibition.

source.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
source.note: MAPK transcriptional-output genes defined by RAF-MEK feedback inhibition analysis (DUSP4, DUSP6, SPRY2, SPRY4, ETV4, ETV5 core; ETV1, FOSL1, CCND1 as ERK-driven effectors).

signatures.label: RAS(ON) inhibition pharmacodynamic readout
signatures.description: ERK-output genes that DECREASE with RAS(ON) inhibition (daraxonrasib / RMC-6236). DUSP6 downregulation was used as the pharmacodynamic marker of MAPK pathway suppression in the RMC-6236 preclinical paper.

source.note: Holderfield et al., "Concurrent inhibition of oncogenic and wild-type RAS-GTP for cancer therapy" (RMC-6236 / daraxonrasib). DUSP6 used as PD readout of MAPK suppression; remaining genes are the canonical ERK-output set that co-varies with DUSP6.
